n: In June 1829, Oliver Cowdery wanted to know how to build up the Church. The Lord answers him (and later David Whitmer) in this revelation about the worth of souls and the calling of the Twelve.

f.w: Oliver Cowdery
f.g: Joseph’s scribe, co-recipient of the priesthood, and one of the Three Witnesses.

n: The Spirit has repeatedly witnessed to Oliver that what he wrote down — the Book of Mormon — is true.

f.w: the things which you have written are true

n: Since he knows it is true, Oliver must rely on what is written there as his guide.
The Book of Mormon contains everything needed about the foundation of Christ’s church, gospel, and rock.

f.w: the foundation of my church, my gospel, and my rock

n: If Oliver builds the church on this foundation, hell will not prevail against him.

f.w: the gates of hell shall not prevail

n: The world is ripening in wickedness, so people everywhere — Gentiles and Israel — must be stirred to repentance.

f.w: ripening in iniquity
f.g: growing toward full readiness for judgment, as fruit ripens for harvest.

n: Joseph baptized Oliver as commanded, fulfilling his duty. (The two baptized each other on May 15, 1829, after receiving the Aaronic Priesthood.)

f.w: baptized by the hands of my servant Joseph Smith, Jun.

n: Don’t be surprised that God has called Joseph for his purposes. If Joseph stays diligent, he will receive eternal life.

f.w: his name is Joseph

n: God commands all people everywhere to repent. Oliver and David are called with the same calling as the Apostle Paul — a hint at apostleship.

f.w: I command all men everywhere to repent
even as unto Paul mine apostle

n: One of the most quoted verses in the D&C: the worth of souls is great in the sight of God. Every person matters infinitely to him.

f.w: the worth of souls is great

n: Why souls are so valuable: Christ died and suffered the pain of all people so that all could repent and come to him.

f.w: he suffered the pain of all men

n: He rose from the dead to bring all people to him, on the condition of repentance.

f.w: on conditions of repentance

n: Christ rejoices greatly over every soul who repents.

f.w: how great is his joy in the soul that repenteth

n: So Oliver and David are called to cry repentance to their generation.
Even if they labored their whole lives and brought just one soul to Christ, their joy with that person in God’s kingdom would be great.

f.w: save it be one soul

n: And if one soul brings great joy, how much greater the joy of bringing many!

f.w: how great will be your joy

n: They have the gospel, Christ’s rock, and his salvation before them.
Ask the Father in Christ’s name with faith, and the Holy Ghost will reveal all that people need to know.

f.w: the Holy Ghost, which manifesteth all things

n: Without faith, hope, and charity, nothing of eternal value can be done.

f.w: faith, hope, and charity

n: Do not fight against other churches, except the “church of the devil” — meaning everything that opposes God, not a single denomination.

f.w: the church of the devil
f.g: In Nephi’s vision, a symbol of all that fights against God, not one specific church.

n: Take Christ’s name upon you and speak the truth seriously and soberly.

f.w: Take upon you the name of Christ
soberness

n: Those who repent, are baptized in Jesus’ name, and endure to the end will be saved — the doctrine of Christ in a single sentence.

f.w: endure to the end

n: Jesus Christ is the only name given by the Father through which people can be saved.

f.w: none other name given whereby man can be saved

n: Everyone must take this name, for it is the name by which they will be called at the last day.

f.w: in that name shall they be called at the last day

n: Those who don’t know the name they are called by cannot have a place in God’s kingdom.

f.w: know not the name by which they are called

n: Others will be called to preach the gospel to both Gentile and Jew.
There will be twelve, who will take Christ’s name with full purpose of heart. This foretells the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, organized in 1835.

f.w: even twelve
full purpose of heart

n: The Twelve are called to take the gospel to all the world and every creature.

f.w: preach my gospel unto every creature

n: They are ordained to baptize in Christ’s name according to the scriptures.
Oliver and David have the written guidance (the Book of Mormon) and must follow it.

f.w: you have that which is written before you

n: The Lord speaks directly to the future Twelve: his grace is sufficient, but they must walk uprightly and avoid sin.

f.w: my grace is sufficient for you

n: The Twelve will ordain priests and teachers and preach the gospel by the power of the Holy Ghost.

f.w: ordain priests and teachers

n: Jesus Christ affirms he has spoken these words.
These words come from Christ, not man, and Oliver and David must testify of that.
When they read these revelations, they are hearing Christ’s voice, given by his Spirit and power. This applies to anyone who reads scripture by the Spirit.

f.w: it is my voice which speaketh them unto you

n: So they can truly testify they have heard Christ’s voice and know his words.
Oliver and David are assigned to find the Twelve who have these righteous desires. In 1835 they, with Martin Harris, selected the first Quorum of the Twelve.

f.w: search out the Twelve
f.g: In February 1835 the Three Witnesses chose the first twelve apostles of this dispensation.

n: They will recognize the Twelve by their desires and works.

f.w: by their desires and their works you shall know them

n: When they find them, they are to share these instructions with them.
They are to humbly worship the Father in Christ’s name.

f.w: worship the Father in my name

n: Their message to the world: repent and be baptized in Jesus Christ’s name.

f.w: You must repent and be baptized

n: Everyone must repent and be baptized — men, women, and children who reach the age of accountability (later specified as eight years old).

f.w: the years of accountability

n: After receiving this, they must keep all of God’s commandments.
Through them, God will do a marvelous work, convincing many of their sins and bringing them to repentance and his kingdom.
The blessings God gives them are above all else.
But if they receive all this and then don’t keep the commandments, they cannot be saved. Greater light brings greater responsibility.

f.w: if you keep not my commandments

n: The revelation closes with Christ’s own seal: spoken by the power of his Spirit.
